notice: SYNTHETIC SAMPLES. Every alert here was written for this demo. The banks (SampleBank, DemoBank, TestPay), names, account endings and amounts are invented. No real bank data is used. Placeholders such as {{amount}} and {{ref}} are filled in by the alert console each time, so every send is a fresh alert.

samples.title: English SMS, credit from SampleBank
samples.name: Ali Raza
samples.template: SampleBank: Rs. {{amount}} credited to A/c XXXX1234 on {{date}} {{time}} from {{name}}. Ref: {{ref}}. Avl Bal: Rs. 48,250.75. Never share your OTP with anyone.
